result:
Only one occurrence today, but the causal pattern (wiring an `FsOperations`-based helper from `storage/fsOperations` into a `set*Fn` callback that expects a plain string contract) can recur elsewhere.

```json
{"file": "src/packages/app-host/src/runtime/installPluginBindings.ts",
 "edits": [{"old": "  setSafeResolvePathFn((base, rel) => safeResolvePath(base, rel) ?? null)",
            "new": "  setSafeResolvePathFn((_base, rel) => safeResolvePath(getFsImplementation(), rel).resolvedPath)"}],
 "patterns": [{"patron": "fs-helper-wired-with-wrong-argument-shape",
               "senal_del_verificador": "TS2322:.*resolvedPath: string; isSymlink: boolean; isCanonical: boolean.*is not assignable to type 'string'",
               "fix_generico": "Cuando un `set*Fn` de `_deps.ts` espera `(base: string, rel: string) => string | null` pero se le pasa directamente `safeResolvePath` de `@thyrox/storage/fsOperations.js` (cuya firma real es `(fs: FsOperations, filePath: string) => { resolvedPath; isSymlink; isCanonical }`), la corrección es invocarla con `getFsImplementation()` como primer argumento (patrón ya usado en el resto del archivo para `existsSync`, `statSync`, etc.) y tomar el campo `.resolvedPath`, no pasar el string `base` en la posición de `fs`.",
```
